label: Patch with Basic Flap
description: The patch-with-flap combines the external, sewn-on construction of the patch pocket with an additional flap that folds over the opening to create a covered closure — a combination that is a cornerstone of American Ivy Style and traditional English country tailoring alike. It is more functional than an open patch and slightly less casual in appearance, remaining firmly in the relaxed category appropriate for sport coats, tweed jackets, and unlined blazers. The flap typically matches the jacket cloth and may be butted to the pocket or slightly overhanging.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
